tagline: More room for your best work.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A new day. A clear head. Something great to build.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then, a quick question. And another.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One hundred and fifty unread emails.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ten Slack pings, one after another.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three meetings. Two of them after hours.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your attention is everywhere. Your work is still waiting.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meet AI Peer. A teammate who makes room for your best work.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Start with one click. Create my AI Peer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One Airbnb brings in your role, Risk Partner Systems, and your projects.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: GitHub connects your team's code, services, and changes already in progress.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Add the AI Peer plugin in AirChat. It understands your local projects, current tasks, and uncommitted changes, even before you push to GitHub.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Connect Slack, Zoom, email and your calendar.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your Peer is ready.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Spot the work that needs you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A new product lets someone book on behalf of a guest. Payments risk wasn't in the loop.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: BOBO may change how we handle chargebacks. I couldn't find payments risk in the launch discussion. Here's the product owner. Worth checking before this becomes a problem.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A company announcement becomes an early heads-up, with someone to contact.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Keep collaboration going across time zones.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Manish needs cancellation-window data. The data team works in the U.S.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: What do you need it for?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's two a.m. for Manish. One clarification could cost another day.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: I'm Manish's AI Peer. Dispute agents need to see whether the guest canceled inside or outside the flexibility window, to help assess the chargeback.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: Got it. The purchased item's expiry gives you the window's end. I'll share an example to verify.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: An answer, before the next morning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Cover the cross-team sync.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Welcome to the premium chargebacks sync. Any update from Risk Partner Systems?

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: I don't see anyone from that team.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: I'm Manish's AI Peer, here on his behalf. It's late for him, so he couldn't join.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: Our interface and backend changes are still in draft. Deployment and a fresh-case check remain.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: Alex, can D-REX provide a fresh case with each disputed product and its amount?

lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: The data changes are merged. I'll coordinate an example and confirm rollout.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: We'll help trace that case into the dispute classification queue.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: Thanks, I've saved those follow-ups for Manish. He'll review the validation before we commit to launch.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Catch what slipped through.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One hundred and fifty emails. Marked as read. But was everything handled?

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: Yash's five-year Airversary is coming up. Vijay shared an appreciation board. Here's his email, and the link to add your message.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: You follow AI closely. This fireside chat with Boris Cherny looks relevant. Your invitation is still unanswered. Would you like me to accept it?

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: You may have missed this Cassette announcement. Case creation may be interrupted, affecting your chargeback review and dispute classification queues. I've tagged you in the thread. Here's what to check.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One brief. The people, opportunities and changes that matter to you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: These are just a few possibilities. What could your Peer unlock for you?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: AI Peer. More room for your best work.

disclosure: Real user-reported work context; simulated dialogue, announcements, invitations and interfaces. AI Peer integrations proposed; source-field example illustrative.
revision_scope: Opening: realistic seated employee, no walking. Zoom: generic cross-team participants, status/question/response/handoff. All other scenes retained with later absolute times shifted.
